Hi Ana — thanks for the clear note. Short answers and next steps below.

Options for invoice delivery (we support both):
- Portal (preferred for enterprise): secure web portal + API push. Invoices are available as PDF and XML. Can support SFTP or push to your AP system.
- Email: we can send PDF copies to a designated AP mailbox; good for smaller teams or if your ERP prefers email ingestion.

Required signer / invoice originator rules:
- We can populate invoices with the authorized issuer name you require (e.g., CFO or AP contact). Typical options are: 
  * "Redwood Inference, Inc. — Accounts Receivable" (standard)
  * Specific approver name for legal PO matching (if you need a named person, share the full name and title).

VAT/tax evidence:
- Attaching our supplier VAT certificate (PDF). We also record our company tax ID on the invoice metadata.

Action items I propose: 
1) Confirm preferred delivery channel (portal or email) and delivery address / API endpoint.
2) Confirm invoice signer/originator text you want on the document (full name & title if you want a named signatory).
3) If portal: confirm SFTP credentials OR provide API endpoint details. If email: provide the mailbox and any PO/matching rules.

I've cc'd Marissa (billing ops) and Connor (AP integrations) so they can pick up implementation once you confirm. I've attached our VAT cert and a sample invoice for format.

Best,
